advanced-filter-description: Umuyungururo uhanitse ushoboza kwandika urukurikirane rurimwo ibi bimenyetso: == != <= >= && || ( ) Akanya gakoreshwa mu gutandukanya ibimenyetso. Ushobora kuyungurura imirima yose yihariye wandika amazina n'agaciro kayo. Nk'akarorero: Field1 == Value1. Menya: Iyo imirima canke agaciro birimwo utwanya, ubishira hagati y'utumenyetso tumwe. Nk'akarorero: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kugira usimbe ibimenyetso bimwe (' \/), ushobora gukoresha \\. Nk'akarorero: Field1 == I\'m. Ushobora kandi gufatanya ibintu vyinshi. Nk'akarorero: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mu bisanzwe ibimenyetso vyose bisomwa kuva ibubamfu kuja iburyo. Ushobora guhindura urutonde ukoresheje utwugarizo. Nk'akarorero: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ushobora kandi kurondera mu mirima y'inyandiko ukoresheje regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Shiraho JSON yasohowe na Kanboard: ikintu gifise "columns" (canke tasks zifise column_name) n'urutonde rwa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns ziba intonde, tasks zikaba amakarata.

import-board-instruction-issues: Shiraho urutonde rwa JSON rw'ibibazo vya __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ibibazo biba amakarata ashizwe mu ntonde Open / Closed.

import-board-instruction-leo: Omekako imiterere ya Leo (idosiye .leo). Ibice vyo ku rwego rwo hejuru bihinduka intonde, ibice bibikomokako ku rwego rukurikira bigahinduka amakarata, kandi igisomwa c'igice kikaba insiguro y'ikarata. globalSearch-instructions-description: Ukurondera gushobora kubamwo abakoresha kugira gutomore ibisubizo. Abakoresha bagenwa mu kwandika izina ry'umukoresha n'agaciro bitandukanywa n'utudomo tubiri. Nk'akarorero, `list:Blocked` igabanya ukurondera ku makarata ari mu rutonde rwitwa *Blocked*. Iyo agaciro karimwo utwanya canke ibimenyetso bidasanzwe gategerezwa gushirwa hagati y'utwuguruzo (nk'akarorero `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - amakarata yo ku bicapo bifise *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - amakarata yo mu ntonde zifise *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - amakarata yo mu mirongo ifise *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amakarata afise akarango gahuye na *<color>* canke *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amakarata yo ku capa cashinzwe ishirahamwe *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amakarata yo ku capa cashinzwe umugwi *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amakarata afise igihe ntarengwa gushika ku misi *<n>* kuva ubu. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ itondeka amakarata yose yarengeje itariki ntarengwa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amakarata yaremwe haciye imisi *<n>* canke mike
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amakarata yahinduwe haciye imisi *<n>* canke mike
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - amakarata yose yashizwe n'atashizwe mu bubiko
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - amakarata yo ku bicapo vya rusangi gusa
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - amakarata yo ku bicapo vyigenga gusa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - aho *<field>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` canke `__predicate_member__`. Gushira `-` imbere ya *<field>* birondera aho agaciro katari muri uwo murima (nk'akarorero `has:-due` irondera amakarata adafise itariki ntarengwa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - aho *<sort-name>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` canke `__predicate_modified__`. Kugira utunganye uva hejuru umanuka, shira `-` imbere y'izina ry'itunganywa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - aho *<n>* ari igitigiri cuzuye kirenga zero cerekana amakarata yerekanwa ku rupapuro rumwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Abakoresha basa bahuzwa na *CANKE*. Amakarata ahuye n'ikigenderwako ico ari co cose arasubizwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` isubiza amakarata ari mu rutonde urwo ari rwo rwose rwitwa *Blocked* canke *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Abakoresha batandukanye bahuzwa na *KANDI*. Amakarata ahuye n'abakoresha bose batandukanye gusa ni yo asubizwa. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` isubiza gusa amakarata yo mu rutonde *Available* afise akarango *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Imisi ishobora kugenwa nk'igitigiri cuzuye kirenga canke kiri munsi ya zero, canke hakoreshejwe `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` canke `__predicate_year__` ku kiringo ca none.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Ukurondera igisomwa ntigutandukanya inyuguti nkuru n'into.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ku buryo mburabuzi amakarata yo mu bubiko ntaronderwa.

database-migration-description: Imura amakuru ashingiye ku gisomwa (vyose kiretse imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha biguma muri sisitemu y'amadosiye) hagati ya MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Ubundi bubiko bw'amakuru butegerezwa kuba buriko burakora kandi bushikwako (ivyambu mburabuzi: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; hindura ukoresheje WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Niwarangira, erekeza MONGO_URL ku bundi bubiko bw'amakuru maze wongere utangure WeKan (kuri Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb canke =mongodb).

database-migration-confirm: Kopa amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku gisomwa muri __db__? Imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha biri muri sisitemu y'amadosiye ntibikorwako. Ububiko bw'amakuru bugenewe kwakira butegerezwa kuba buriko burakora.
sandstorm-migration-description: Igihe WeKan ikorera mu grain ya Sandstorm, ububiko bwayo bwa kera bwa MongoDB 3 bwimurirwa muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ku gutangura kwa mbere, kandi imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha bikurwa mu bubiko bw'amakuru bikajanwa mu bubiko files/attachments na files/avatars bwa grain. Ibi vyerekana ko iryo yimurwa ryagenze neza n'umwanya wo kuri disiki amadosiye ya kera adahinduwe ya MongoDB agikoresha muri grain, kandi bikagufasha kuyafuta kugira ubohore umwanya.

feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Akazi gasigaye n'akaheze, urugendo rw'akazi rwegeranijwe, igihe c'uruziga n'ico gushikiriza, urugero rw'akazi kaheze, igihe akazi kamaze, intambamyi, Monte Carlo n'izindi ngero z'ingene ibikorwa bigenda.
feature-approval-required: Reka ubushobozi bwongerwa n'amavugurura ya WeKan buzimye gushika umuyobozi abwuguruye
feature-preview-admins: Abayobozi babona ubushobozi buzimye kugira ngo babanze babugerageze
feature-pilot-users: Abakoresha b'igerageza na bo babona ubushobozi buzimye
cards-loading-description: WeKan ishira amakarata y'icapa ubwayo: icapa kinini (kirenze urugero rw'ubunini) gishira gusa amakarata aboneka ubu (kuzunguruka kutagira iherezo) hamwe n'igitigiri gihinduka ubwo nyene, kugira kigume cihuta kandi gikoreshe ububiko n'urubuga bike; ibicapo bitoyi vyo bigashira ikarata yose kugira bikore mu buryo bworoshe kandi bwuzuye. Nta co kugena gihari. Abayobozi barashobora guhatira uburyo bakoresheje CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ugushira amakarata make kuracageragezwa: ibitigiri vy'amakarata n'imbibe za WIP ni vyo, ariko uburyo bwa Calendar/Table/Gantt no guhitamwo vyinshi vyerekana gusa amakarata amaze gushirwa. Subira ushire ibicapo vyuguruye inyuma yo guhindura ibi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Igihe bikora, amahuza yose (amahuza ya markdown nka [label](url) n'ibirango vya HTML <a href> bidahinduwe) yama yerekanwa nk'igisomwa gisanzwe kidakandwako mu mirima yose y'igisomwa gikize (imitwe y'ibicapo n'amakarata, insiguro, insasanuro, intonde zo kugenzura, n'ibindi). Ibi birabuza amahuza akandwako ashobora guhenda. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye, amahuza rero aguma akandwako.
always-show-code-as-text: Yama werekana kode yose nk'igisomwa gisanzwe
always-show-code-as-text-description: Igihe bikora, igisomwa gikize nticigera cerekanwa nka markdown canke HTML: isoko yose yama yerekanwa nk'igisomwa gisanzwe mu mirima yose y'igisomwa gikize (imitwe y'ibicapo n'amakarata, insiguro, insasanuro, intonde zo kugenzura, n'ibindi). Ibi vyerekana ibinyegejwe — insasanuro za HTML (<!-- -->), iyo amahuza ya markdown yerekeza, JavaScript n'iyindi kode yose — kode yose rero yama iboneka, ntikandwako kandi ntikora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye, markdown rero yerekanwa uko bisanzwe.
disable-all-import-description: Igihe bikora, ubushobozi bwose bwo kwinjiza burazimwa: kwinjiza icapa kivuye muri WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, hamwe no gukopa icapa. Amahitamwo yo kwinjiza aranyegezwa kandi seriveri ikanka ubusabe bwose bwo kwinjiza. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-all-export-description: Igihe bikora, ubushobozi bwose bwo gusohora burazimwa: gusohora icapa nka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, canke muri NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, hamwe no gusohora umugereka umwe. Amahitamwo yo gusohora aranyegezwa kandi seriveri ikanka ubusabe bwose bwo gusohora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-import-avatars-description: Igihe bikora, amashusho y'abakoresha ntiyigera yinjizwa. Ibi birimwo ukwinjiza WeKan JSON, ukwinjiza Trello no guhuza amashusho ava ku batanga umwidondoro bo hanze igihe co kwinjira (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amazina n'ayandi makuru biracakinjizwa; amashusho y'abakoresha gusa ni yo asimbukwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-export-avatars-description: Igihe bikora, amashusho y'abakoresha ntiyigera ashirwa mu gusohora icapa (gusohora WeKan JSON na CSV). Amazina y'abakoresha n'ayandi makuru aracasohorwa; amashusho y'abakoresha gusa ni yo arekwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
anonymize-import-users-description: Igihe bikora, kwinjiza icapa ca WeKan JSON bisubiriza izina ry'uwukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intango vy'uwukoresha wese yinjiye n'ibisubirizi bifise ibitigiri (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho yiwe kandi bikongera kwandika aho @username ivugwa (n'imirima y'uwabisavye / uwabishinze) mu makarata n'insasanuro vyinjijwe. Nta mwidondoro nyakuri w'uwukoresha wo ku capa c'isoko ubikwa. Ijambo "uwukoresha" rikurikira ururimi rw'uwinjiza. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
anonymize-export-users-description: Igihe bikora, gusohora icapa bisubiriza izina ry'uwukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intango vy'uwukoresha wese asohorwa n'ibisubirizi bifise ibitigiri (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho yiwe kandi bikongera kwandika aho @username ivugwa (n'imirima y'uwabisavye / uwabishinze) mu makarata n'insasanuro. Dosiye isohowe nta mwidondoro nyakuri w'uwukoresha itwara. Ijambo "uwukoresha" rikurikira ururimi rw'uwusohora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Igihe bikora, gusohora icapa bisubiriza izina ry'uwukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intango vy'uwukoresha wese asohorwa n'ibisubirizi bifise ibitigiri (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho yiwe kandi bikongera kwandika aho @username ivugwa (n'imirima y'uwabisavye / uwabishinze) mu makarata n'insasanuro. Dosiye isohowe nta mwidondoro nyakuri w'uwukoresha itwara. Ijambo "uwukoresha" rikurikira ururimi rw'uwusohora. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-activities-description: Igihe bikora, ivyandikwa mu ruhererekane rw'ibikorwa ntivyigera vyandikwa kandi ntivyerekanwa ahantu na hamwe (ku ruhande rw'icapa no mu gice c'ibikorwa vy'ikarata). Nta mateka y'uwakoze iki abikwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-notifications-description: Igihe bikora, WeKan ntiyigera irungika imenyesha zo gukurikirana (muri porogarama, imeyili canke izindi serivisi) ku gikorwa ico ari co cose. Ibikorwa birashobora kuguma vyandikwa (kiretse na vyo bizimijwe hejuru); imenyesha gusa ni zo zihagarikwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
disable-watch-description: Igihe bikora, ubushobozi bwo gukurikirana burazimwa — abakoresha ntibashobora kwiyandikisha ku bicapo, intonde canke amakarata kugira baronke imenyesha, kandi igerageza ryose ryo guhindura urugero rwo gukurikirana rirankwa. Ku buryo mburabuzi birazimye.
backup-description: Bika kopi y'Imigereka, Amashusho y'abakoresha na/canke Amakuru (amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku gisomwa atari imigereka canke amashusho y'abakoresha). .zip irungikwa ubwo nyene mu bubiko bwatowe — nta dosiye y'igihe gito — nka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, irimwo YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Ububiko bwo mu gicu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) bukoresha imyirondoro yagenwe mu duce twabwo tw'ububiko.
backup-scope-description: Porogarama yose canke Ishirahamwe rimwe. Kopi yo gukingira y'Ishirahamwe irimwo ibicapo vyaryo n'ibiri kuri vyo vyose, harimwo imigereka y'ivyo bicapo — ariko nta makonti y'abakoresha canke ibigenwa vya porogarama, kuko bisangiwe n'Amashirahamwe yose. Kugarura kopi y'Ishirahamwe kwandika gusa ku bicapo iryo Shirahamwe rifise.
continuous-backup-description: Irungika ihinduka ryose ryo mu bubiko bw'amakuru, imigereka, amashusho y'abakoresha n'inyandiko z'ibikorwa mu bubiko bumwe mu masegonda make, kugira ngo bishoboke kugarura ivyariho igihe cose. Ikorana na kopi yo gukingira itegekanijwe, ikora amakopi yuzuye.
continuous-backup-enabled: Koresha kopi yo gukingira ibandanya kuri iyi seriveri
continuous-backup-target: Ububiko bwo gushiramwo (inzira yuzuye, ku yindi disiki, mu bubiko busangiwe ku muhora canke ahahujwe na rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Impapuro za SQLite (impapuro zahindutse mu kiringo cose categekanijwe)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nta moteri y'ububiko bw'amakuru ishobora gukora kuri iyi seriveri
continuous-backup-encrypt: Nyegeza kopi yo gukingira ukoresheje kode (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Dosiye y’urufunguruzo rwo kunyegeza ukoresheje kode (inzira yuzuye iri hanze y’ububiko bwo gushiramwo; indome 64 zo mu buryo bw’ibiharuro bushingiye kuri 16 canke interuro y’ibanga ifise n’imiburiburi indome 16). Bika kopi: iyo dosiye itariho, kopi yo gukingira ntishobora kugarurwa.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Nta hantu (mu bubiko bwo gushiramwo gusa)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Ububiko bwa dosiye buri mu gitebo co kubikamwo
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Dosiye y'ububiko bw'amakuru SQLite (ikorerwa iruhande ya kopi yo gukingira, ntiyigera yandikwa hejuru ya dosiye iriko irakoreshwa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Koresha ububiko bw’amakuru SQLite bwongeye kwubakwa igihe gikurikira sisitemu izosubira gutangura (ububiko bw’amakuru bwa kera busubirijwe buzobikwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Garura urukurikirane rwa kopi rwatowe ku gihe catowe? Kopi yo gukingira ibandanya irahagarara akanya gato mu gihe co kugarura.
continuous-backup-saved: Amatunganyo ya kopi yo gukingira ibandanya yabitswe
backup-restore-select-first: Banza uhitemwo kopi yo gukingira ku rutonde.
backup-restore-confirm: Garura kopi yo gukingira yatowe? Imigereka/amashusho y'abakoresha yandikwa muri sisitemu y'amadosiye, amakuru akandikwa mu bubiko bw'amakuru hakurikijwe uburyo bwatowe.
gcs-key-filename: Inzira ya dosiye y'urufunguzo rwa konti ya serivisi
gcs-key-filename-description: Si ngombwa: inzira ya dosiye y'urufunguzo JSON rwa konti ya serivisi kuri seriveri.
gcs-credentials-description: Si ngombwa: nimanika urufunguzo JSON rwa konti ya serivisi. Sigaza ubusa kugira ukoreshe dosiye y'urufunguzo canke imyirondoro mburabuzi.
gcs-permissions-note: Ha konti ya serivisi ya WeKan uburenganzira bwo gusoma/kwandika mu ndobo: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → indobo yawe → Permissions → Grant access. Muri "New principals", nimanika imeyili ya konti ya serivisi — agaciro ka "client_email" kari mu rufunguzo rwawe JSON — hanyuma uhitemwo uruhara "Storage Object Admin" maze ukande Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Sigaza ubusa kugira ugumize agaciro kariho.
azure-account-name-description: Izina rya konti yawe ya Azure Storage.
gcs-project-id-description: ID y'umugambi wawe wa Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Izina ry'indobo ya Cloud Storage yo kubikamwo amadosiye.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: sigaza ubusa (ikoresha aho akarere gahurira). Ihura na S3: Endpoint URL iva muri console yawe ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → indobo yawe → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → izina ry'indobo yawe (canke Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → uwukoresha wawe → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → hitamwo ikoreshwa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Ryerekanwa nka 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Ku rupapuro rumwe na Access key ID; 'Secret access key' yerekanwa rimwe gusa igihe urufunguzo ruremwe — kope ubwo nyene (canke Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → izina ryerekanwa hejuru (no munsi ya Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → Data storage → Containers → ikibikwamwo cawe (canke + Container kugira ukireme).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → igitora umugambi kiri hejuru → ID y'umugambi wawe (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → izina ry'indobo yawe (canke Create kugira uyireme).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Inzira iri kuri seriveri ya WeKan ijana kuri dosiye y'urufunguzo JSON rwa konti ya serivisi wamanuriye (yaremwe hasi). Koresha iyi CANKE unimanike JSON mu murima wo hasi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → konti yawe ya serivisi → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (imanura dosiye). Nimanika ibirimwo hano, canke ubike dosiye maze ugene inzira yayo hejuru.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Himurira umugereka muri Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Himurira umugereka muri Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Koresha MongoDB GridFS mu kubika amadosiye
migration-stop-confirm: Urazi neza ko ushaka guhagarika iyimurwa ryose?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Kugira imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha biboneke, bimure muri CollectionFS ubijane mu bundi Bubiko ubwo ari bwo bwose.
s3-access-key-description: Urufunguzo rwo gushika kuri AWS S3 rwo kwemeza umwidondoro
s3-access-key-placeholder: Injiza urufunguzo rwo gushika kuri S3
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket name for storing files
s3-enabled-description: Koresha AWS S3 canke MinIO mu kubika amadosiye
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com or minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Urufunguzo rw'ibanga rwa AWS S3 rwo kwemeza umwidondoro
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Koresha SSL/TLS ku mahuza ya S3
writable-path-description: Inzira y'ububiko bw'intango bwo kubikamwo amadosiye
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Rirakora isuzuma ryuzuye n'ikosora ry'ukutawononekara kw'amakuru y'icapa, harimwo uko intonde zikurikirana, ibibanza vy'amakarata n'imiterere y'imirongo.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Rifuta neza intonde z'ubusa zisubiwemwo. Rikuraho gusa intonde zidafise amakarata KANDI zifise urundi rutonde rufise umutwe umwe rurimwo amakarata.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Rirondera kandi rigarura amakarata n'intonde zibuze swimlaneId canke listId. Rirema umurongo 'Amakarata Yazimiye' kugira ibintu vyose vyazimiye vyongere biboneke.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Rigarura imirongo, intonde n'amakarata vyose vyashizwe mu bubiko. Rikosora ubwa ryo swimlaneId canke listId iyo ibuze kugira ibintu biboneke.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Rimenya kandi rigakosora intonde zibuze canke zononekaye mu miterere y'icapa.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Rihindura URL z'amashusho y'abanywanyi b'icapa kugira zikoreshe ububiko bubereye kandi rigakosora aho amashusho yononekaye yerekeza.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Rihindura URL z'imigereka yose y'amadosiye kuri iki capa kugira zikoreshe ububiko bubereye kandi rigakosora aho amadosiye yononekaye yerekeza.
migrations-admin-only: Abayobozi b'icapa gusa ni bo bashobora gukoresha iyimurwa
migrations-description: Koresha isuzuma n'ikosora ry'ukutawononekara kw'amakuru y'iki capa. Iyimurwa rimwekimwe ryose rishobora gukoreshwa ukwaryo.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Ibi birakora iyimurwa ryuzuye kugira bisuzume kandi bikosore ukutawononekara kw'amakuru y'icapa. Bishobora kumara akanya gatoyi. Bandanya?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Ibi bizobanza guhindura intonde zisangiwe zibe intonde za buri murongo, hanyuma bifute intonde z'ubusa zifise urutonde rusubiwemwo rufise umutwe umwe kandi rurimwo amakarata. Intonde z'ubusa zisubiramwo vy'ukuri gusa ni zo zizokurwaho. Bandanya?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Ibi bizorema umurongo 'Amakarata Yazimiye' kandi bigarure amakarata n'intonde vyose bibuze swimlaneId canke listId. Bikora gusa ku bintu bitashizwe mu bubiko. Bandanya?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Ibi bizogarura imirongo, intonde n'amakarata VYOSE vyashizwe mu bubiko, vyongere biboneke. Ikintu cose kibuze ID kizokosorwa ubwa co. Ibi ntivyoroha gusubizwa inyuma. Bandanya?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Ibi bizomenya kandi bikosore intonde zibuze canke zononekaye mu miterere y'icapa. Bandanya?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Ibi bizohindura URL z'amashusho y'abanywanyi b'icapa kugira zikoreshe ububiko bubereye. Bandanya?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Ibi bizohindura URL z'imigereka yose y'amadosiye kuri iki capa kugira zikoreshe ububiko bubereye. Bandanya?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Nta mirongo, ntonde canke makarata vyazimiye vyo kugarura
migration-progress-note: Turagusavye urindire igihe turiko twimurira icapa cawe ku miterere nshasha...
conversion-info-text: Iri hindurwa rikorwa rimwe ku capa kimwekimwe kandi rigateza imbere umuvuduko. Urashobora kubandanya ukoresha icapa uko bisanzwe.
converting-board-description: Kuriko harahindurwa imiterere y'icapa kugira gikore neza kurushiriza. Bishobora kumara akanya gatoyi.
migration-batch-size-description: Igitigiri c'imigereka yo gukorerwa mu mugwi umwekimwe (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Hagarika gatoyi iyimurwa igihe ikoreshwa rya CPU rirenze iki gipimo (10-90)
migration-info-text: Iyimurwa ry'ububiko bw'amakuru rikorwa rimwe kandi rigateza imbere umuvuduko wa sisitemu. Igikorwa kibandanya inyuma naho wokwugara mucukumbuzi yawe.
migration-warning-text: Turagusavye ntiwugare mucukumbuzi yawe igihe c'iyimurwa. Igikorwa kizobandanya inyuma ariko gishobora kumara igihe kirekire kugira kirangire.
showChecklistAtMinicard: Erekana Urutonde rwo Kugenzura ku Karata Ntoyi
sign-in-to-upload: Injira kugira ushireko ububiko bwa kode
account-locked: Konti yugariwe akanya kubera kugerageza kwinjira incuro nyinshi bikanka. Turagusavye wongere ugerageze hanyuma.
username-too-short: Izina ry'uwukoresha ritegerezwa kugira n'imiburiburi ibimenyetso 3
problems-summary-help: Suzuma uturere tw'ingorane waravye, hanyuma ukande Emeza ko wabibonye kugira usubize kuri zero igitigiri c'ingorane nshasha.
problems-in-progress-help: Iri yimurwa canke ikosora ririko rirakorwa ubu. Ukwinjira gushobora guteba, canke kukerekana ‹Utegerezwa kuba winjiye› canke agashusho ka ‹Kuriko birashirwa, turagusavye urindire›, gushika birangiye kandi CPU igabanutse.
problems-none-in-progress: Nta kwimura canke gukosora biriko birakorwa.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Hakosowe amakarata __fixed__. Amakarata __unfixable__ nta capa afise kandi ntashobora gukosorwa ubwayo.
export-card-details: Ibisobanuro vy'ikarata (ikarata imwekimwe nk'uko iri mu gusohora ikarata)
import-here-instruction: Injiza hano dosiye yasohowe na WeKan (.json canke .zip):
import-not-wekan-export: Iyo dosiye si iyasohowe na WeKan
import-board-source: Injiza icapa (Trello, Jira, dosiye yasohowe na WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Icapa carakozwe, ariko ibice bimwebimwe vya dosiye ntivyashoboye kwimurwa. Iyo raporo ibikwa muri Ikibaho c'umuyobozi → Ingorane → Kugarura.
import-parts-instruction: Ibice vyashizweko ikimenyetso gusa ni vyo vyinjizwa. Ihitamwo rimwe rirakoreshwa no mu gusohora.
import-wekan-file: Injiza bivuye muri dosiye .json canke .zip yasohowe:
sum-of-number-fields: Igiteranyo c'ibipimo vy'imibare zihariye zerekanwa hejuru y'urutonde
date-range-of-fields: Igihe c'imirwi y'itariki yagenywe kugira ngo yerekanwe hejuru y'urutonde
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Kwemeza ibintu bibiri birakoreshwa kuri konte yawe.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Ongera urwego rw'umutekano ku konte yawe. Iyo bikoreshejwe, uzokwinjiza kode ivuye ku porogaramu yo kwemeza igihe cose winjira.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Sikana iyi kode QR na porogaramu yo kwemeza (nka Google Authenticator, Authy), hanyuma winjize imibare 6 iyerekana kugira ngo wemeze.
twoFactorCode-prompt: Injiza kode yawe yo kwemeza y'imibare 6
twoFactorCode-invalid: Kode yo kwemeza sivyo. Ongera ugerageze.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: Amakarata __remaining__ akiri afunguye; nta biherutse kurangira kugira ngo havugwe itariki.
chart-forecast-projected: Ku muvuduko wa vuba wa makarata __average__ ku ndwi, amakarata __remaining__ akiri afunguye yotegerezwa kurangira ku __date__.
list-sync-description: Gukomeza uru rutonde ruvugurura ruvuye ku gikoresho co hanze. Akazi kari inyuma kararaba buri miniti 15; koresha "Huza ubu" kugira ngo uraabe ubu ubu.
drag-to-reorder: Kurura kugira uhindure urukurikirane. Utubuto tw’imyampi ija hejuru no hasi twimura ikibanza kimwe.
map-view-empty: Iki capa ntikiragira ishusho y'ikarata y'ahantu. Umuyobozi w'icapa arashobora gushirako ishusho — igishushanyo c'igorofa, ikarata y'ahantu canke igishushanyo — hanyuma amakarata y'ibikorwa agashirwa kuri yo.
map-view-place-hint: Kurura ikarata y'igikorwa uyishire ku ikarata y'ahantu, canke uyitore hanyuma ukande aho ikwiye kuja.
map-view-all-placed: Amakarata y'ibikorwa yose ari ku ikarata y'ahantu.

email-recovery-description: Umurongo umwe ku muntu wese yakira. Rondera ukoresheje ID y'uwukoresha. Ibiri mu butumwa n'ibibanza vy'imeyili vy'uwakira ntivyerekanwa. Guhagarika gatoyi bifata ubutumwa busanzwe n'ubwo muri kazoza; Kubandanya bisubira kugerageza kurungika ubutumwa buri ku murongo ubu. Guhagarika burundu bikuraho ubutumwa bwashizwe ku murongo gushika ku gihe c'igisabo. Nimba kurungika bikiriko birakorwa, subira ugerageze mu kanya. Ubutumwa bwatanguye kurungikwa ntibushobora kugarurwa, kandi irungikwa ritazwi neza uko ryagenze rishobora gusubirwamwo. Ibitagenze neza burundu n'ubutumwa bwashitse ku rugero ntarengwa rw'igerageza bigumaho kugira bisuzumwe. Gusubira kugerageza ubutumwa butarungitswe neza bitangura ikiringo gishasha c'igerageza kandi bigumana ihagarikwa rya gatoyi risanzwe.

rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ivyabitswe kuri iri gerageza ntivyemewe, rero ntirishobora gutorerwa umuti hano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ntivyashobotse gutorera umuti iyi meyili. Subira ufungure urupapuro maze wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-description: Izi meyili z'amategeko zateguwe n'ubwoko bwa kera bwa WeKan butanditse aho ibizirimwo vyavuye, rero WeKan ntizozirungika ubwayo. Banza usuzume ko uwashizeho itegeko agifise uburenganzira bwo kwinjira, maze usubire guhuza imeyili kugira itegurwe bushasha hakurikijwe ikarata uko iri ubu, canke uyihebe.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ibisobanuro vy'ikarata vyo mu bwoko bwa kera
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Wosubira gutegura iyi meyili ukurikije ikarata uko iri ubu? Ibiyirimwo bishobora gutandukana n'ivyari vyateguwe imbere.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ntivyashobotse kuzana imeyili z'amategeko zirindiriye gusuzumwa. Subira ufungure urupapuro kugira wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Uwashizeho itegeko ntagifise uburenganzira bwo kwinjira kuri iyi karata, canke itegeko ryarahindutse, rero imeyili ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Igikorwa catumye iyi meyili itegurwa carahindutse, rero ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikarata iyi meyili yavuyeko ntikiboneka, rero ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ishirwa mu ngiro ry'itegeko ryateguye iyi meyili ntirikibitswe, rero ntishobora gusubira guhuzwa. Urashobora kuyiheba.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Iyi meyili yamaze kurungikwa, kugeragezwa kurungikwa canke guhebwa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ntivyashobotse kurangiza iki gikorwa. Subira ufungure urupapuro maze wongere ugerageze.
saml-login-not-started: Uku kwinjira ukoresheje SAML ntikwatanguriye muri iyi tabi y’umucukumbuzi. Subira winjire.
history-request-pending-undo: Seriveri ntiremeza ugusubiza inyuma ihinduka ryawe rya nyuma.
history-request-pending-redo: Seriveri ntiremeza ugusubira gukora ihinduka ryawe rya nyuma.
history-request-hint: Gusubira kugerageza bisubiramwo ca gisabo nyene, rero ntibishobora kwigera bisubiza inyuma irindi hinduka.
login-setting-clear-secret: Kuraho agaciro kabitswe mu kibaho c'umuyobozi
login-setting-after-restart: Bitangura gukora inyuma yo gusubira gutanguza WeKan
